## Treasury and Signing Authority Policy

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - Department - owner: Valdemar Peltonen

## 1. Signing limits

Payments and commitments require approval according to the limits below. Two signatures are required above EUR 50,000.

| Role | Single approval limit |
|---|---|
| Department head | EUR 50,000 |
| Executive (C-level) | EUR 500,000 |
| CEO | EUR 2,000,000 |
| Board | Above EUR 2,000,000 |

## 2. Cash management

Surplus cash is held with at least three banks rated A- or better, with no more than 40% at any single bank.

FX exposures above EUR 1 million equivalent are hedged at 75% for the following 12 months.

## 3. Bank accounts

Opening or closing bank accounts requires approval by the CFO (Valdemar Peltonen) and the CEO.
